repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a cycle that repeats indefinitely (until is null). The candidate incorrectly includes an 'else' branch that re-executes the body actions on every iteration. At t=60000ms, the IR only emits an email action (the cycle body), while the candidate emits both the valve close and the email action again. The candidate must remove the else branch to match the infinite loop behavior.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the 'else' block that caused duplicate actions on subsequent iterations. The script now consists of a single conditional block that waits for the leak and executes the actions, followed by an infinite loop that repeats only the cycle body actions.
